title: The Old Hound
summary: A veteran hunting hound, who had tackled fierce boars and stags in his youth, seized a wild boar by the ear. But his worn teeth slipped from the animal's hide, and the prey escaped...
full_text:
A veteran hunting hound, who had tackled fierce boars and stags in his youth, seized a wild boar by the ear. But his worn teeth slipped from the animal's hide, and the prey escaped.

His ungrateful master ran up and struck the old dog with his whip.

The bleeding hound looked up with sorrowful eyes: "Master, my heart was willing, but my strength has failed with age. Praise me for what I have accomplished in your service, rather than beating me because my youth has departed!"
moral: Honor past service; do not reproach an old servant whose strength fails after years of devotion.
